description: Compute the potential-determining free-energy step of the nitrogen reduction reaction on Ru(001) via the distal mechanism.
user_prompt: Compute the nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) free-energy profile on the flat Ru(001) HCP basal surface (space group P6_3/mmc) via the associative distal mechanism under the Computational Hydrogen Electrode (CHE) model. The pathway begins with end-on N2 chemisorption, followed by six PCET steps proceeding through *NNH, *NNH2, *N, *NH, and *NH2 intermediates, with NH3 released after the third and sixth PCET steps. Build the CHE free-energy ladder at U = 0 V vs RHE and identify the potential-determining step. Report the free energy of the potential-determining PCET step, delta_G_rds = max(delta_G_1..6) (in eV), evaluated over the six PCET steps only.

references: Skulason, Bligaard, Gudmundsdottir, Studt, Rossmeisl, Abild-Pedersen, Vegge, Jonsson & Norskov, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 14, 1235 (2012)
method.modeling: Use a flat Ru(001) slab with at least 4 layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom, and a 2x2x1 or larger surface cell; model end-on *N2 and the distal *NNHx/*NHx sequence on the basal terrace. Build the CHE free-energy ladder at U = 0 V vs RHE and identify delta_G_rds from the six PCET steps; the non-electrochemical N2 chemisorption step is diagnostic only.

key_parameters.free_energy_corrections: CHE with ZPE and entropy corrections at 298 K

method.rationale: Skulason et al. report that the first PCET step on flat Ru(001), *N2 + (H+ + e-) -> *NNH, is 1.08 eV uphill in free energy and is the potential-determining step for the distal NRR pathway. The corresponding limiting potential is the derived quantity U_L = -delta_G_rds/e = -1.08 V vs RHE, while the benchmark scores only delta_G_rds. Montoya et al. provide a later BEEF-vdW volcano cross-check placing Ru near the NRR activity optimum with a limiting potential around -1.0 to -1.1 V; the +/-0.20 eV tolerance covers functional, coverage, slab, and free-energy-correction differences.
